notices.title: \ポップアップ/
notices.description:
\ポップアップ/

本日より206号室のLUNA様によるポップアップがはじまりました✨

お二人の作家様による
布小物や手編み小物、畳縁のアイテムやレジンのアクセサリーなど
様々な手作り品がテーブルいっぱいに並びました。

可愛い生地で作られたポーチや、猫耳が可愛い巾着は
ご自分用はもちろん、ギフトにも人気のアイテムです。

ホイップを絞ったような形が可愛い手編み帽子は、これからの季節にぴったりな温かい素材の毛糸で編まれています。
単色やグラデーションカラーなど、コーディネートに合わせて使い分けるのも◎
寒い時期のお出かけに気分を上げてくれそうです♪

少し変わった素材を使ったアイテムも！
畳縁(たたみへり)で作られたお薬手帳やキーホルダーは
持ち歩いていると会話のきっかけになりそうな、ワクワクするアイテムです。
カラフルでポップなデザインや、シックで落ち着いたデザインなど柄も様々です。

レジンやボタンを組み合わせて作られたオリジナルアクセサリーは
キラキラパーツや猫ちゃんパーツがレジンに閉じ込められていたりと
一点一点異なるデザインです。
ブローチ、ヘアピン、指輪、ネックレスなど
ぜひじっくり眺めてお気に入りを見つけてください😊

LUNA様によるポップアップは10/10(土)まで
店内メインテーブルにて開催中です。
皆さまのご来店を心よりお待ちしております☺︎

translation.title: Pop-up
translation.description:
Pop-up Shop!

Starting today, a pop-up shop by LUNA, the makers from Room 206, has begun! ✨

The tables are filled with a variety of handmade items by two artists, including fabric accessories, hand-knitted items, tatami mat edging items, and resin accessories.

Pouches made from cute fabrics and drawstring bags with adorable cat ears are popular items for personal use or as gifts.

The cute hand-knitted hats, shaped like whipped cream, are made with warm yarn perfect for the coming season.

They come in solid colors and gradient colors, so you can choose one to match your outfit!

They're sure to brighten your mood when you go out in the cold weather!

There are also items made with slightly unusual materials!

Medicine notebooks and keychains made from tatami mat edging are exciting items that are sure to spark conversations.

They come in a variety of patterns, from colorful and pop designs to chic and sophisticated ones.


These original accessories, crafted from resin and buttons, feature unique designs with sparkling parts and cat-shaped charms encased in resin.
Brooches, hairpins, rings, necklaces, and more—please take your time to browse and find your favorite! 😊
LUNA's pop-up shop is open until Saturday (10/10) at the main table in the shop.
We look forward to your visit! ☺︎

🏡
Craft Apartment Nippori
〒116-0014 Higashi-Nippori, Arakawa-ku, Tokyo 6-17-8
Business Hours: 11:00〜17:00
Closed: Sundays and public holidays

translation.title: Pop-up
translation.description:
Pop-up Shop!

Starting today, the pop-up shop "red white blue sometime pink" by BOOOOOOO (booooooo.co), the maker from Room 203, has begun!

As the title suggests, it features amigurumi, stuffed animals, and fabric accessories in red, white, blue, and pink.

Each piece is meticulously crafted with attention to detail.

Each item is unique and possesses an irresistible cuteness that will tug at your heartstrings.

Please take your time to browse! ☺️

The amigurumi come in various sizes, from small ones around 2cm to large ones exceeding 30cm!

These small amigurumi are recommended for combining with larger amigurumi, or with your existing stuffed animals and dolls 🧸

Bears, ducks, dogs, rabbits, and more
The space is so exciting and fun, you can almost hear the animals chatting!
Enjoy BOOOOOOO's unique world 🌳

The event runs until Saturday, 10/3.

We look forward to your visit! ☺︎
